5:12.sourceText: καὶ γὰρ ὀφείλοντες εἶναι διδάσκαλοι διὰ τὸν χρόνον, πάλιν χρείαν ἔχετε τοῦ διδάσκειν ὑμᾶς τινα τὰ στοιχεῖα τῆς ἀρχῆς τῶν λογίων τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ γεγόνατε χρείαν ἔχοντες γάλακτος, οὐ στερεᾶς τροφῆς.
5:12.targetText: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!

groups.note: Greek because of the time is expressed as by this time in the expected-teaching statement. The complete preposition/article/time phrase supplies the temporal expectation without pretending its causal preposition independently means by.

The actual again adverb and teaching infinitive are rendered with the single prefixed English reteach word. They must be grouped; an artificial re substring would not identify a complete displayed English word.
The actual indefinite Greek τινα is the someone who teaches. The earlier articular-infinitive marker τοῦ is not a pronoun and must not carry someone.
Greek of the beginning qualifies the principles; English compresses that genitive modifier to basic. The article and beginning noun retain the whole modifier identity.

The Greek genitive article/oracles phrase specifies what the basic principles concern; BSB expresses that relation as of ... word, with Gods inserted as the separate possessor. Greek plural oracles is rendered collective singular word; the case relation remains attached to the actual word/oracles head, not to Gods possessive.

Greek you have become having need is compressed to You need. The becoming finite verb, need noun and having participle jointly supply this actual predicate; the English does not separately express its transition-of-state nuance.

unmappedSource.reason: N1904 introduces the expectation with even/and for; BSB gives a concessive Although. These unlike connective forms are not presented as the same Greek word.
Greek article nominalizes the teaching infinitive; English directly uses the teaching infinitive without a separately expressed nominalizing article.
BSB starts a new sentence at You need milk without expressing the Greek and there.

unmappedTarget.reason: BSB introduces the contrast with Although, where N1904 writes even/and for before the ought-to-be-teachers construction.
